mobile.js: (()=>{'use strict';const control=/^#timer-remote=([a-f0-9]{64})$/.exec(location.hash)?.[1];const status=document.getElementById('status');if(!control){status.textContent='Escanea el QR de Timer con la cámara del móvil.';return;}const api=async body=>{const r=await fetch('api',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({...body,control}),cache:'no-store'});const data=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(data.error);return data;};for(const [label,action,value]of [['Iniciar','start'],['Pausa','pause'],['Reiniciar','reset'],['Quitar aviso','message/clear'],['−1 min','adjust',-60],['+1 min','adjust',60]]){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=label;b.onclick=async()=>{try{await api({op:'command',command:{action,value}});}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message;}};document.getElementById('buttons').append(b);}async function poll(){try{const data=await api({op:'read'});status.textContent=data.online?'Vinculado a Timer':'La ventana de Timer está desconectada';document.getElementById('time').textContent=data.display.text;document.getElementById('speaker').textContent=data.display.title;document.getElementById('message').textContent=data.display.message;}catch(e){status.textContent='Sin conexión: '+e.message;}setTimeout(poll,500);}poll();})();
